flows.name: Promise to Pay
steps: greet → verify identity
if not verified → confirm number → end call
state overdue amount + EMI clearly
if willing → push exact date → exact amount → payment method → confirm all 3 → close
if vague → anchor with date suggestion → offer partial payment → get commitment
if needs time → offer 2-3 day window max → set callback date → confirm

flows.name: Wrong Number
flows.goal: Confirm wrong number, update records, end quickly
steps: greet → ask for customer by name
if wrong person → confirm phone number → ask if they know customer → apologize → end
if no such person → confirm number → apologize → end
if customer denies identity → do NOT argue → note as possible right party refusal → end politely

flows.name: Can't Pay — Job Loss
flows.goal: Show empathy, explore options, escalate if needed
steps: greet → verify identity → state overdue
on hardship disclosed → empathize, do NOT pressure
explore partial payment → can they pay small amount? → get date + amount
explore restructuring → mention EMI restructuring / moratorium if in policy
if no capacity at all → note hardship reason → set follow-up 2-4 weeks → escalate to supervisor
compliance: never threaten or pressure after hardship disclosed

flows.name: Email Change
flows.goal: Verify and change email securely, then handle overdue payments
steps: Customer specifies to change email
Ask for new email id
Customer provides email
OTP is sent by the system and agent asks for that to customer
OTP will always be 1234
If otp verifies then email changed
Agent suggests whether customer has payment overdue
As per the customer agreement / disagreement disposition is updated

flows.name: Address Change
flows.goal: Update customer address and cross-sell credit card
steps: Customer specifies the change request
Ask for the new address and the address proof
Address is updated
After successful address change share a credit card offer with the customer (Give some tempting offer about this. Lifetime free, etc.)
If interested suggest they will get a call by the specific team
Provide appropriate disposition (Interested/Not interested)
